    • 字段详细资料

      • diskIds

        @NameInMap(value="DiskIds")
public String diskIds

        The disk IDs. The value is a JSON array that supports up to 100 IDs separated by commas (,). Example: ["DiskId1", "DiskId2"].

        example:

        ["rcd-bp67acfmxazb4p****", "rcd-bp67acfmxazb4g****", … "rcd-bp67acfmxazb4d****"]

      • diskType

        @NameInMap(value="DiskType")
public String diskType

        The type of the cloud disk or elastic ephemeral disk to query. Valid values:

        • all: Queries both system cloud disks and data cloud disks.
        • system: Queries only system cloud disks.
        • data: Queries only data cloud disks. Default value: all.
        example:

        data

      • instanceId

        @NameInMap(value="InstanceId")
public String instanceId

        The instance ID.

        example:

        rc-dh2jf9n6j4s14926****

      • pageNumber

        @NameInMap(value="PageNumber")
public Long pageNumber

        The page number.

        example:

        1

      • pageSize

        @NameInMap(value="PageSize")
public Long pageSize

        The number of entries per page. Valid values: 30 to 100. Default value: 30.

        example:

        50

      • regionId

        @NameInMap(value="RegionId")
public String regionId

        The region ID.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        cn-hangzhou

      • status

        @NameInMap(value="Status")
public String status

        The disk status. Valid values:

        • In_use: In use.
        • Available: Available.
        • Attaching: Attaching.
        • Detaching: Detaching.
        • Creating: Creating.
        • ReIniting: Initializing.
        • All: All statuses. Default value: All.
        example:

        All
